name: Bayesian model selection in simultaneous multivariate linear regressions (SSMR)
model_likelihood: Y_i = X_c,i B_c,i + X_g,i B_g,i + E_i with matrix-normal residuals in non-overlapping subgroups.
prior: Candidate-model probabilities and conditional covariance-magnitude priors; beta_g | W_g ~ N(0,W_g); independent flat limiting controlled-coefficient priors and inverse-Wishart residual covariances.
inference_algorithm: Exact null-based Bayes factors for known residual covariances; Laplace plug-in ABFs for unknown covariances; posterior model enumeration or MCMC.
estimand: Posterior probabilities of nonzero-coefficient configurations xi(beta_g).
data_input: Individual-level quantitative response matrices, explanatory-variable matrices such as genotypes, and controlled-covariate matrices.
tunable_settings: Candidate-model probabilities; context-specific effect-correlation mapping and covariance-magnitude distribution; inverse-Wishart m_i and H_i; ABF weights alpha_i in [0,1].
